title: DXF consumer-route and bridge artifact maturity
mode: Primary-source web research with bounded local plan and harness audit
scope: Expand the peer map to an open-source DXF callback consumer and a current DWG-to-DXF application bridge.
Distinguish file-open success, callback delivery, bridge conversion, writer disposition, and semantic/native acceptance.
Refine optional comparator admission and existing FreeCAD validation without adding routine peer runs or new prerequisites.

sources.revision: Public QCAD master/project and current API documentation reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: QCAD describes itself as an open-source 2D CAD application; its README says DWG support is available through an optional proprietary plugin. Its DXF module is based on dxflib. DL_Dxf::in routes group data through a caller-supplied creation interface, drains the group reader to EOF, and returns true once the file could be opened.
sources.limits: Documentation is not a runtime result. File-open success does not establish complete parse, callback coverage, semantic field fidelity, writer compatibility, or an open DWG parser.

sources.revision: Mutable project parity document and helper source reviewed 2026-10-20; no immutable commit was executed or independently resolved in this pass.
sources.observed: The parity document describes DWG reads as an ACadRust 0.6.3 DWG-to-ASCII-DXF bridge followed by a separate DXF read. It marks AC1012/AC1014 untested and AC1032 real-file testing untested; later roundtrips listed are synthetic. It says proxy, ACIS, and custom-object output loss is unmeasured. The helper uses failsafe reading, derives notes from skipped source records, performs cleanup/postprocessing, then serializes DXF.
sources.limits: This is application-authored scope evidence, not independently reproduced codec coverage. Skipped-record notes do not inventory later cleanup or writer omissions. Results cannot be transferred to another ACadRust package or release without binding that artifact.

sources.observed: The release is a separate artifact from CADCraft's documented ACadRust 0.6.3 dependency.
sources.limits: No package was downloaded or executed. This observation establishes only a version/provenance distinction, not a compatibility result.

sources.revision: Public documentation reviewed 2026-10-20; GitHub marks the documentation repository archived on 2026-04-01.
sources.observed: The route documentation distinguishes selectable C++ and legacy Python importer subsets and states that stock FreeCAD importers do not read ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.limits: Archived documentation is a route description, not runtime qualification for a future FreeCAD build or selected importer.

localCrosswalk.observation: The existing harness removes its test-local output before conversion, checks successful process status and expected ASCII DXF/version, performs a dwg2dxf readback with version check, and requires atomic refusal for selected unsupported records. It is a converter/CLI check, not a native FreeCAD application import. No new test was needed.

The plan already treats ACadRust-derived applications as a shared parser lineage and keeps FreeCAD converter/importer/modeler outcomes separate. The new section narrows QCAD to a DXF callback consumer, records the file-open-only meaning of its documented boolean result, and tightens CADCraft artifact and source-to-output accounting.

planChanges: Added QCAD/dxflib as an optional DXF callback-consumer comparator only; documented that its DWG plugin is proprietary and its boolean read result only confirms file-open status.

Recorded CADCraft's documented ACadRust 0.6.3 DWG-to-DXF bridge, synthetic versus real-file qualification limits, and unmeasured proxy/ACIS/custom-object loss without treating it as an independent parser.
Required distinct accounting for source decode/skip diagnostics, bridge cleanup, output writer disposition, and independent reopen; preserved exact package/source artifact identity.
Confirmed reuse of the existing FreeCAD-form CLI harness, whose fresh-output, status, DXF-version, readback, and refusal checks do not substitute for a native application import.
limitations: All peer sources are public project documentation/API/source; no peer binary or native application was run.
CADCraft's parity page is mutable and was not pinned to a commit in this research-only pass; its assertions remain advisory until exact artifact binding.
QCAD documentation does not establish complete DXF compatibility or DWG support through the proprietary plugin.
